name: B10-0296/2026 (PfE) – Russia’s unacceptable provocative actions and drone incursions into Romania, the Baltic states and Finland
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on Russia’s unacceptable provocative actions and drone incursions into Romania, the Baltic states and Finland
part_text:
The European Parliament condemns Russian drones entering the airspace of Romania, Latvia, Poland, the Baltic states and Finland, including a drone that hit a home in Galați, Romania, in May 2026 and hurt civilians. It asks Russia to stop, backs the countries affected, and wants better drone detection, protection of airports and power plants, and facts checked before blame is assigned. It is an opinion; it does not change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. It is a statement of position, not a law.
- **Who it affects:** EU countries near Russia, plus Russia, which is asked to stop.
- **What happens next:** The text is sent to EU governments and Russia; countries are urged to improve airspace defence.
